description:
Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

Human approval gate for the completed feature. Present the two SMTP controls, validation messages, saved/reopened behavior, existing failure switch, planned partial/failed delivery display and ordinary text behavior. Existing approval from old attachment-policy work does not approve this new UI.
Files: review notification_smtp_live and existing channel delivery presentation; no new production code in this gate.
Tests/scenarios before approval: exercise component/LiveView and integration checks from implementation; define final consolidated browser scenarios in the E2E issue. Do not author new/substantially rewritten feature E2E until explicit human approval of completed UX is recorded.
Branches: valid/missing/invalid SMTP limits, failure-switch preservation, selected connector versus default and safe partial errors.
Mocking: existing external provider fixtures.
Docs: record approval scope/evidence in this issue. Reopen on material UX changes.
Action reuse: human verification only; no new operation.
title: [zaq-1lw.10] Approve completed SMTP and attachment-delivery UX before E2E
